latHint: Think being brilliant at maths - not a bright light.
pivHint: Glitter makes things SHINE - but to SHINE at maths means to do what at it?
winText: Top of class. SHINE was the pivot - bright glitter to EXCELling.
lossText: EXCEL - to be outstanding. SHINE was the pivot: glittery SHINE to being brilliant, to SHINE at something.
